title: SKG: A Law-Induced Engine from Inference to Induction
abstract: arXiv:2610.19505v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper proposes the SKG (Symplectic-Kernel Gradient) reasoning engine for law-induced inference and induction. Laws are a priori; data provide instances. Inference is geometric evolution under law constraints. We organize symplectic geometry, GENERIC, kernel methods, RKHS, group-equivariant networks, and constrained mechanics into a unified, analyzable, implementable, verifiable framework. We propose the SKG octuple S = (M, g, omega, H, S, G, Delta, Pi), whose four components correspond to four levels of laws: conservation laws, constitutive relations, symmetry groups, and axiom systems.   Main results: (1) Invariants enter metric construction via the Jacobian: g = J^T Sigma^-1 J + epsilon_G I. For constant cases, we establish inverse reconstruction theory: solvability rank condition (Thm 3.9), consistency criterion (Thm 3.11), and uniqueness theorem (Thm 3.14). translated_title: SKG：从推理到归纳的定律驱动引擎
translated_abstract: 本文提出了SKG（辛核梯度，Symplectic-Kernel Gradient）推理引擎，用于定律驱动的推理与归纳。定律是先验的，数据提供实例，推理则是定律约束下的几何演化。我们将辛几何、GENERIC框架、核方法、再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）、群等变网络和约束力学整合为一个统一的、可分析的、可实现的、可验证的框架。我们提出了SKG八元组 S = (M, g, ω, H, S, G, Δ, Π)，其四个组成部分对应四个层次的定律：守恒律、本构关系、对称群和公理系统。主要结果：(1) 不变量通过雅可比矩阵进入度量构造：g = J^T Σ^-1 J + ε_G I。对于常数情形，我们建立了逆重构理论：可解性秩条件（定理3.9）、一致性判据（定理3.11）和唯一性定理（定理3.14）。(2) 核带宽矩阵由Fisher信息唯一确定（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SKG推理引擎，将辛几何、核方法与约束力学统一为一个八元组框架，把守恒律、本构关系、对称群和公理系统四个层次的定律嵌入学习过程，实现了从先验定律驱动的推理到归纳的统一、可验证的方法体系。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SKG, a symplectic-kernel-gradient reasoning engine that unifies symplectic geometry, kernel methods, and constrained mechanics into an octuple framework embedding four levels of laws—conservation laws, constitutive relations, symmetry groups, and axiom systems—for law-induced inference and induction.
